text: Chat in my laptop. I have other messaging applications that you cannot use, and so I need to speak with the administrative staff so that I can give the slides to them, and perhaps they can share them with you on WeChat or whatever you guys can use. Because unfortunately, we don't have the same applications. I have got WeChat on my phone, but not on my laptop, and I cannot transfer all the slides into my phone and then share them using WeChat. So sorry about that, but we need the help of the administrative staff to do that. Okay. When we have a long break, I will go upstairs and ask the administrative staff how to do that. So hopefully by today we will receive the slides.
